derivations.what: Show that if the components of q and k are independent with mean 0 and variance 1, then q·k has mean 0 and variance d_k.
derivations.hint_step: Write q·k as a sum of d_k terms q_i·k_i. Work out the mean and variance of ONE term first, using independence.

derivations.what: Show that for a fixed offset k, the sinusoidal encoding PE(pos+k) can be written as a linear function of PE(pos).
derivations.hint_step: Take one sin/cos pair with the same frequency ω and apply the angle-addition formulas to sin(ω·pos + ω·k) and cos(ω·pos + ω·k).
